verdict.rationale: cubic runs unattended on every PR through its GitHub app, with no UI interaction needed. It can auto-fix issues, auto-approve low-risk PRs, and be configured as code via cubic.yaml, which together deliver hands-off automation. It also ships a CLI and an Analytics API, but the CLI is documented only for reviewing local changes before push, with no evidence of headless or CI-pipeline use. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions usage, exit codes, API keys for CI), independent corroboration of CI usage.
